name: ElringKlinger AG
summary: ElringKlinger AG develops, manufactures, and sells components, modules, and systems for the automotive industry in Germany, rest of Europe, North America, the Asia-Pacific, and internationally. It operates through four segments: Original Equipment, Aftermarket, Engineered Plastics, and Other.
